text: Ayran is yoghurt thinned with water and lightly salted after fermentation, so it keeps the yoghurt cultures' acidity and flavour in a thin, drinkable form.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: The yoghurt is thinned until its protein is above 1.6 %.
